newsitem.title: UK: LME copper creeps higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper creeps higher in late trading.

text.p: LME copper edged higher in late inter-office trading on Thursday evening, but analysts said the market still looked weak.
At 1800 GMT, three months copper was quoted at $2,486/89, up from an afternoon kerb close of $2,481.
Over the past three days, the market has seen lower highs each day, failing to surmount the psychological $2,500 mark.
The market may be moving back into surplus as the slow summer period approaches, analysts said.
Zinc was a touch higher after a day of strong gains, indicated at $1,379/84 after a $1,375 kerb close.
The other metals were little changed.
